authority: exact SHA-pinned T6 PC dedicated-server EXE + linker MAP

closedFacts.producerRule: SD_UpdateVoice builds SD_GetVoiceParam(index) for a started driver voice and SD_VoiceSetParam atomically replaces voiceNewParam[index]
closedFacts.supersededVoiceParamRule: a replaced non-null pending voiceNewParam is immediately returned through SD_VoiceParamFree
closedFacts.globalMixRule: SD_MixSetParam atomically replaces a separate global pending mix-master pointer and frees the superseded pointer

proofBoundary: Authoritative only for the dedicated-server producer/control side. The stripped per-voice consumer mixer DSP, sample-rate conversion, pan law, bus/master summing, speaker matrix, XAudio2 submission semantics, and retail t6mp.exe address equivalence remain unproven.
